item.description: Half of Hong Kong’s government departments and public bodies have not disclosed their greenhouse gas emissions data and some calculations have been based on outdated information, a green group has found. item.description: Residents of Malaysian villages near the Thailand border were left shaken this weekend after hearing loud booms and seeing flashes of light across the frontier, as Thai authorities confirmed more than 50 coordinated attacks on Saturday night. item.title: Kazakhstan election: pro-Tokayev party set for landslide as president hints at staying on
item.description: A party led by allies of Kazakhstan President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev won a landslide in parliamentary elections on Sunday, hours after he hinted that he may stay in power beyond his current term. The Adilet party won 71.8 per cent of votes in the election to a new single-chamber parliament, according to an exit poll released on state television. The Auyl party representing agrarian interests was second with 6.4 per cent. “I have the right to be re‑elected in accordance with the law,” Tokayev told... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Record non-DSE admissions to Hong Kong’s universities spark calls for quotas
item.description: Hong Kong public universities have admitted a record number of students applying outside the local exam system, with the intake surging by 63 per cent over seven years to account for nearly 30 per cent of the 15,000 government-funded places, the South China Morning Post has found. Meanwhile, the intake of home-grown students taking the Diploma of Secondary Education (DSE) exam has dropped by 7 per cent, causing its proportion to fall from 82 per cent to 72 per cent, sparking calls for a cap on... item.title: Homicide Ruling Detailed: LA examiner finds Celeste’s death was homicide; D4vd lawyers deny murder
item.description: A newly unsealed medical examiner’s report has revealed that Celeste Rivas Hernandez died from multiple penetrating injuries, with her death officially classified as a homicide. The findings add a major development to the case involving streamer D4vd, who faces a first-degree murder charge and has pleaded not guilty. His attorneys maintain his innocence, while Celeste’s family continues to seek justice following the teenager’s death and disturbing discovery of her remains. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: Hasan Piker has responded to backlash over singing “We Are Charlie Kirk” during a live show, dismissing what he called repeated “fake outrage.” In a fiery stream, the Twitch commentator claimed he was more respectful toward Charlie Kirk than Erika Kirk and criticized Republicans attempting to carry Kirk’s legacy. Khan has been in prison since 2023 and was sentenced late last year along with his wife to 17 years on corruption charges they both deny. item.title: A businessman bought a 23,000-acre Scottish sporting estate and spent two decades rewilding it
item.description: An ambitious English businessman has reimagined a historic Scottish hunting estate as a lush wilderness reserve. His initiative, which includes the planting of over one million native trees, has revived populations of red squirrels in the glens. The project also emphasizes the restoration of peatlands and the breeding of Scottish wildcats, with funding from upscale eco-tourism driving significant conservation efforts to protect and restore local ecosystems for the future. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
